title: GradingExtraQuestion
description: An additional per-task question the reader answers beside the verdict — SPEC-confirmation-run-r3.md §11 guard 2's *does a delivered passage other than the construction passage answer the question?* on the pointed read. The answer travels in `GradingVerdict.extra_answers` keyed by `id`.

id.description: Stable key for the answer; unique within the task.

text.description: The question as shown to the reader.

answer_type.description: `yes-no`: the answer MUST be the string `yes` or `no`. `text`: any string.
